continuity_scope: HBO's Game of Thrones television continuity only, bounded to Season 1 Episode 1, "Winter Is Coming" (2011), using the official HBO episode page as the primary audiovisual witness and HBO's official teaser as supplementary release context. The A Song of Ice and Fire novels, House of the Dragon, games, later episodes, and all other adaptations are excluded.
work_or_witnesses: Game of Thrones, S1 E1: Winter Is Coming, HBO official episode page / primary episode witness
HBO official Winter Is Coming teaser (2010)
coverage_rule: Include named individual members of the premiere's principal on-screen family and ruling groups: the central Stark household, the Baratheon/Lannister royal party, and the Targaryen/Dothraki marriage party. This yields Eddard, Catelyn, Robb, Sansa, Arya, Bran, Jon, Robert, Cersei, Jaime, Tyrion, Joffrey, Daenerys, Viserys, and Khal Drogo. Secondary household, guard, adviser, and messenger roles; off-screen historical names; houses, peoples, titles, religions, magic, artifacts, places, institutions, and political offices are terms or omissions.
omissions: Named but secondary premiere figures, unnamed individuals, and off-screen historical names are excluded by the stated principal-group rule; later episodes receive separate passes.
The A Song of Ice and Fire novels, House of the Dragon, games, promotional game material, and other adaptations are separate continuities and are not merged.

The episode contains child peril, political coercion, death/violence, and a sexual/incestuous situation. This pass does not describe graphic action, sexual content, consent, pregnancy, injury outcome, or later consequences; it records only narrow kinship/spousal links where needed and directly evident.
No real-world race/ethnicity, class, gender, disability, religion, monarchy, or historical equivalence is inferred from HBO's fictional houses, offices, peoples, or casting.
uncertainties: The official HBO episode URL is cited as the primary audiovisual witness with scene-range locators; publicly fetched page text is access-limited, so this is not a transcript-derived pass.

Titles and offices are retained as fictional terms rather than asserted as fixed social identities. The opening witness does not establish complete genealogies, inner motives, sexual identities, diagnoses, or later political revelations.
The term Dothraki is used only as the series' fictional people/culture descriptor visible in the primary episode; no one-to-one real-world cultural inspiration claim is made.
evidence_basis: HBO's official primary episode locator plus an official HBO teaser only. No fan wiki, Wikipedia, recap, novel, game, transcript, or later-series material is used as evidence.
